native_rule: SHOTS/SEC = 1/dtimeBurst; DAMAGE/SEC = (projectile power + blastPower) × SHOTS/SEC × GA[c_gaDamageGuns]; DAMAGE CLASS is the projectile damageType printed through weaponDamageClassString
notes: One set of rows per mounted gun (native's pane shows one hovered part; V2 shows every gun).

native_item: weapon RANGE and SPEED GA rules
native_rule: An ammo round's speed is projectile speed × GA[c_gaSpeedAmmo]; range = that speed × lifespan; an energy round keeps the projectile speed and multiplies the range by GA[c_gaLifespanEnergy]
notes: The pane prints numbers without suffixes (native comments say they should read 'm'/'mps'); the sheet carries the units.

native_rule: DAMAGE = (missile power + blastPower) × GA[c_gaDamageMissiles]; RANGE = initialSpeed·lifespan + ½·acceleration·lifespan²; LOCK TIME = lockTime; MAX LOCK = maxLock×100 %; DAMAGE CLASS through magazineDamageClassString
notes: Launcher part records resolve to their expendable missile type by ExpendableTypeId.

native_rule: For an OT_probeType expendable: RANGE = (probe projectile lifespan × speed)/1.2, × GA[c_gaSpeedAmmo] when the probe carries ammo, or scannerRange × GA[c_gaScanRange] when the probe has no gun; HIT POINTS and LIFESPAN are raw; VISIBILITY = signature/GA[c_gaSignature] × 100
notes: The 1.2 divisor is native's pane-only estimate of detection coverage, not a sim rule.

native_rule: Mine DAMAGE = mine power; RADIUS = the derived mine radius (native pdmt->radius, the DataMineTypeIGC tail field); LIFESPAN = lifespan; VISIBILITY = signature/GA[c_gaSignature] × 100
notes: MineRadius (P832d) is used, not the shadowed DataObjectIGC radius.

native_rule: STRENGTH (%) = effectiveness × 100 where effectiveness = chaffStrength/2 when chaffStrength ≤ 1, else 1 − 1/(2·chaffStrength)
notes: Pane-only effectiveness measure; the sim's spoof roll keeps its own native formula (FedSrv.CPP:5688-5707).

native_rule: STRENGTH = maxStrength × GA[c_gaMaxShieldShip]; RECHARGE = STRENGTH / (rateRegen × GA[c_gaShieldRegenerationShip]) — seconds to refill, printed with no unit; DEFENSE TYPE = 'normal' for 8 else 'NA'
notes: Because the native number is a refill TIME, the delta direction is LowerIsBetter.

native_rule: CLOAKING = maxCloaking × 100 %; DURATION = -1 ('unlimited') when energyConsumption ≤ hull rechargeRate, else hull maxEnergy (GA-scaled) / (energyConsumption − rechargeRate)
notes: The unlimited case is native's text, not a number; the sheet carries it as the row's Text.

native_item: afterburner pane TOP SPEED and DURATION
native_rule: TOP SPEED = hull max speed (GA-scaled) × (1 + afterburner maxThrust / the RAW DataHullTypeIGC.thrust); DURATION = hull maxFuel / (maxThrust × fuelConsumption); SIGNATURE divides by GA[c_gaSignature]
notes: The boost denominator is the GA-free hull thrust; using the boosted thrust is a common port mistake.
